grid_filter_note: Inside the study union bounding box, retain points outside all 379 OneMap island footprints (sea proxy), or within 5000 m of a study island footprint. This is a footprint-based sea proxy, not a surveyed coastline or reef mask. Study-area polygon membership is recorded separately; sea in the bounding box outside the administrative union is retained for exposure context.
endpoint_method: Centroid of each OneMap polygon in EPSG:32643, transformed to EPSG:4326; use representative_point in the same projection if centroid lies outside polygon. Endpoints are island-area proxies, not surveyed harbours. Midpoints use the WGS84 geodesic between consecutive endpoints, not claimed sailed paths.

weather.dataset_note: ECMWF IFS historical analysis assembled by Open-Meteo, about 9 km, hourly. Explicitly selected because the documented ERA5 variable matrix does not provide wind gusts.

marine.dataset_note: NOAA NCEP GFS Wave archived model forecast, documented 0.25 degree grid (about 25 km), hourly, available since June 2024. Selected after ERA5-Ocean returned null/undefined for all requested wind-wave and swell components. No ERA5-Ocean values enter the final table.

review_thresholds.comment: Provisional review thresholds for exploratory analysis, not safety limits; organisers and marine experts must review them.

plausible_ranges.comment: Broad diagnostic ranges only. Outliers are reported with point and hour and are never dropped or clipped.
